#+TITLE: Marked tables and alignment cookies (known differences)

org-plot's data file drops the marker column and special rows, but its column
numbers and x-type check still count them. Sheets reads Org column numbers and
checks only the data rows.

#+CONSTANTS: users=400 churn=3
#+PLOT: ind:2 deps:(3) with:lines
| ! | Month | Customers |
|---+-------+-----------|
| # |     1 |         0 |
| # |     2 |         0 |
| # |     3 |         0 |
|---+-------+-----------|
|   |  Year |         0 |
#+TBLFM: $3=$users*(1-$churn/100)^($Month-1);%.0f::@>$3=vsum(@I..@II)

#+PLOT: ind:1 deps:(2) with:lines
| x   | y   |
|-----+-----|
| <r> | <l> |
| 1   | 3   |
| 2   | 5   |
